name: zypheron
description: AI-powered cybersecurity assistant for penetration testers and security researchers

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgRed.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:osint" "npm run dev:scanner" "npm run dev:crawler" "npm run dev:packet-manipulator"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently --prefix-colors "bgCyan.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgRed.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:osint" "npm run dev:scanner" "npm run dev:crawler" "npm run dev:packet-manipulator" "npm run dev:bruteforce"
scripts.build:services: npm run build:scanner && npm run build:crawler && npm run build:packet-manipulator
scripts.build:packet-manipulator: cd backend/services/packet-manipulator && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. && make
scripts.start:osint: cd backend/services/osint && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt --quiet && python osint_service_simple.py
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.install:python-deps: cd backend/services/osint && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.services: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgRed.bold" "npm run start:osint" "npm run start:scanner" "npm run start:crawler" "npm run start:packet-manipulator"
scripts.all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgRed.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run start:osint" "npm run start:scanner" "npm run start:crawler" "npm run start:packet-manipulator"
scripts.setup: npm run check-prereqs && npm run install:all && npm run install:services
